categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Yuanchen Environmental Protection Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of new materials including filtration materials, denitrification catalysts, and PTFE micropowders. The company also provides environmental testing services covering air, soil, and water. Its core products focus on dust filtration materials and SCR denitrification catalysts, serving industries such as power generation, steel, cement, waste incineration, chemical, and new energy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as ultra-clean electrostatic bag asymmetric gradient technology, electret treatment, PTFE composite emulsion membrane technology, and integrated dust removal and denitrification technology. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including customized order-based production, strict quality control adhering to TQM standards, and integrates intelligent environmental island solutions combining AI, edge computing, and digital twin technologies. The R&D system includes pre-research, process embedding, product development, and pilot testing to ensure innovation and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major state-owned and private enterprises in power generation (notably coal-fired power plants), steel, cement, waste incineration, chemical, and new energy industries. Notable clients are State Power Investment Corporation, Longjing Environmental Protection, Everbright Environment, Huashu Co., Anfeng Steel, China Resources Cement, and Sinopec. The company also serves emerging markets in smart environmental management and overseas markets along the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hefei, Anhui Province. It has expanded overseas with offices and agents in Europe, East Asia, Southeast Asia, and Arab countries. The company plans to shift from offshore exports to nearshore and onshore production to better serve international markets and reduce supply chain risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yuanchen Technology operates mainly in the midstream of the environmental protection supply chain, focusing on the production of core filtration materials and catalysts used in industrial flue gas treatment. It also extends upstream into raw material procurement and downstream into integrated environmental solutions and third-party testing services, providing comprehensive lifecycle management and smart operation services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes deepening its core environmental protection materials business, expanding market share in key industries, and advancing AI-driven smart environmental island solutions. R&D focuses on high-temperature, corrosion-resistant filter bags, SCR catalysts for low and ultra-low temperature applications, integrated dust removal and denitrification materials, and composite current collectors for lithium batteries. It emphasizes innovation in intelligent environmental management, carbon reduction technologies, and overseas market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized filtration materials and denitrification catalysts to industrial clients via bidding and negotiated contracts. Additional income streams include third-party environmental testing services, smart environmental island operation and maintenance services, and government subsidies. The company also invests in financial assets and receives investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yuanchen Technology holds a strong brand recognition in the industrial flue gas treatment sector, ranking among the top five in domestic high-temperature filtration materials and third nationally in SCR denitrification catalysts for steel sintering. The industry is highly competitive with low concentration, but the company maintains advantages through technological innovation, specialized product focus, and integrated service offerings. It competes with large state-owned and private enterprises in the environmental protection equipment manufacturing industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 629.7 million, a 20.11% increase year-over-year, but a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 60.86 million, reflecting intensified market competition and increased costs. Total assets stood at RMB 1.265 billion, slightly down 4.18%, with net assets of RMB 549.7 million, down 10.56%. The company invests about 5.88% of revenue in R&D, maintaining steady growth in revenue despite profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yuanchen Technology differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies that enable ultra-low emission filtration and denitrification solutions with high efficiency and durability. Its integrated 'product + service' model offers comprehensive lifecycle management, including smart environmental island solutions that leverage AI and digital twin technologies for optimized pollution control and operational efficiency. The company emphasizes high-quality, customized products tailored to stringent environmental standards, supported by strong R&D capabilities and extensive industry certifications.
